headlines.title: Terran Orbital Names Jamin Brown Chief Operating Officer
headlines.summary: IRVINE, Calif., September 29, 2026--Terran Orbital, a Lockheed Martin company and a global leader in satellite-based solutions primarily serving the aerospace and defense industries, today announced the appointment of Jamin Brown as Chief Operating Officer (COO).

headlines.title: Anti-Drone (Counter-UAS) Market Report Forecasts Growth from $4.8 Billion (2026) to $12.6 Billion by 2036, Profiling Lockheed Martin, Thales, DroneShield & 12 Other Key Players
headlines.summary: The global anti-drone (Counter-UAS) market was valued at USD 4.1 billion in 2025 and is projected to grow from USD 4.8 billion in 2026 to USD 12.6 billion by 2036, at a 10.2% CAGR. Growth is driven by rising drone security threats, defense modernization, and critical infrastructure protection.

headlines.title: Can Lockheed Martin (LMT)’s Backlog Keep Growing at this Pace?
headlines.summary: Lockheed Martin Corporation (NYSE:LMT)’s backlog reached a record $230 billion at the end of the second quarter, up 38.3% from the prior year, and an increase of $36.8 billion from December 2025.

headlines.title: Pentagon Deepens F-35 Bet: Lockheed Martin (LMT) Secures $871M Support Contract Modification
headlines.summary: On September 18, the Department of War (DoW) awarded Lockheed Martin Corporation (NYSE:LMT) an $871 million modification to an existing F-35 Lightning II contract. The award lifts the ceiling to provide additional capacity for support equipment under the site activation and sustainment efforts.

headlines.title: What Is Lockheed Martin (LMT) Building In Defense AI And Space?
headlines.summary: Lockheed Martin (NYSE:LMT) is expanding in directed energy weapons, AI-driven military drones and space-based computing platforms in 2026. Recent industry reports released this week highlight the company as a key defense contractor across lasers, microwave defenses and autonomous systems. Analysts point to growing global defense interest in AI-enabled satellite onboard computing that can process data directly in orbit.

description: Lockheed Martin Corporation, an aerospace and defense company, engages in the research, design, development, manufacture, integration, and sustainment of technology systems, products, and services in the United States, Europe, Asia, the Middle East, and internationally. The company operates through four segments: Aeronautics; Missiles and Fire Control (MFC); Rotary and Mission Systems (RMS); and Space. The Aeronautics segment offers combat and air mobility aircraft, unmanned air vehicles, and related technologies. The MFC segment provides air and missile defense systems; tactical missiles and precision strike weapon systems; logistics; fire control systems; mission operations support, readiness, engineering support, and integration services; and ground vehicles. The RMS segment offers military and commercial helicopters, surface ships, sea- and land-based missile defense systems, radar and laser systems, sea- and air-based mission and combat systems, command and control mission solutions, cyber solutions, simulation and training solutions, and services and support for surface ships. The Space segment provides satellites; space transportation systems; strategic, advanced strike, and defensive systems; and classified systems and services in support of national security systems. This segment also provides network-enabled situational awareness; and integrates space and ground global systems to help its customers gather, analyze, and securely distribute critical intelligence data. It primarily serves the U.S. government and international customers, as well as foreign military sales contracted through the U.S. government. The company was formerly known as The Lockheed Corporation and changed its name to Lockheed Martin Corporation in March 1995. Lockheed Martin Corporation was founded in 1912 and is based in Bethesda, Maryland.
